description: Probe of the NPC needs system under combat and knock-out (OFFICE_LIFE_SIMS_BUILD_PLAN SIMS-1). Seven office staff get thirsty, caffeinated and tidy; the player can attack and knock them out mid-errand and watch what drops, what resumes, and what survives a reload. Nothing to solve.
test_objective: Prove needs NPCs behave under attack: a walking NPC turns hostile and aborts its carry; a knock-out drops the held item once and survives a reload; a hostile-from-start NPC never starts a job; a sight catch fires on a walking NPC; a knocked-out partner's coupled partner breaks alone; a still NPC knocked out before its print reveals nothing; a reload before a revealed page is taken clears the tray
